event.title: Pressure Mounts on Zelenskyy to Hold Elections Amid Ongoing Martial Law
event.canonical_title: Pressure Mounts on Zelenskyy to Hold Elections Amid Ongoing Martial Law
event.summary: Ukraine's former defense minister has called for presidential elections, challenging President Zelenskyy. Elections have been suspended since February 2022 due to martial law, which remains in effect. The call for elections highlights the growing pressure on the government to address democratic processes during wartime.

timeline.title: Zelenskyy Opposes Wartime Elections, Citing Risks to National Unity
timeline.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has rejected the idea of holding elections during wartime, stating that it could potentially split the country. His comments follow a call for such elections from the recently dismissed defense minister. Zelenskyy also mentioned concerns about Russia's plans to mobilize a significant number of troops after upcoming elections in Russia.
key_facts: He cites risks of national division.
Comments follow a call from the ex-defense minister.
Concerns raised about Russian troop mobilization.

timeline.title: Early Voting Begins in Russian-Occupied Ukraine Ahead of Elections
timeline.summary: Russia has initiated early voting for its parliamentary elections in areas of Ukraine's Donetsk region under its control. The voting process is reportedly accompanied by armed personnel who are present with election officials and voters.
key_facts: Early voting has started in Russian-controlled areas of Ukraine.
The elections are for Russia's parliamentary seats.
Armed personnel are accompanying election officials and voters.
